scope: All 132 live v019 razsmatr-/razmatr- consider/examine tokens plus one malformed existing razgledky phrase.
choice: Normalize 116 examination/consideration contexts to the official razgled- paradigm, recast sixteen genuine German Überlegung contexts with official type-1 razvaž- nouns, and repair bez vsakoj razgledky neprěryvnosti as bez vsakogo razgleda neprěryvnosti.
motivation: The inherited text mixed a type-3 Russian/BCS-shaped family with an official broad examination family. Context inspection against German also showed that a blanket razgled- conversion would be wrong in sixteen reflective-deliberation nouns; those require razvaž-. The split removes national morphology while preserving the source's semantic distinction.
alternatives_rejected: Normalize all 132 sites to razgled- without source review; sixteen German Überlegung contexts mean reflective deliberation.
Retain råzsmatrjati as an equal variant; the official entry is type 3 and explicitly RU/SH-derived.
Use razvaž- for every site; most contexts mean examine, consider as an object, or take into account, not ponder/reflect.
